source.author: stat
source.text: his labor inserto torrere exsanguia ferro viscera caesarum pecudum, his cumulare canistris perdomitam saxo Cererem; laetatur Arrastus obsequio fervere domum.
source.text_original: his labor inserto torrere exsanguia ferro / viscera caesarum pecudum, his cumulare canistris / perdomitam saxo Cererem; laetatur Arrastus / obsequio fervere domum.
source.text_english: Their task was to scorch with inserted steel the bloodless entrails of slaughtered beasts, and with these baskets to heap up the grain subdued by the stone, while Arrastus rejoices that the house is bustling with dutiful service.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: fervere cuncta virum coetu, simul undique cernit delatum nemus et docta resonare bipenni litora; iam pinus gracili dissolvere lamna Thespiaden iungique latus lentoque sequaces molliri videt igne trabes, remisque paratis Pallada velifero quaerentem bracchia malo.
reuse.text_original: fervere cuncta virum coetu, simul undique cernit / delatum nemus et docta resonare bipenni / litora; iam pinus gracili dissolvere lamna / Thespiaden iungique latus lentoque sequaces / molliri videt igne trabes, remisque paratis / Pallada velifero quaerentem bracchia malo.
reuse.text_english: he sees all things seething with a company of men, and at the same time the grove brought in from every side and the shores echoing with the skilled double axe; already the pine is being split into thin planks, the Thespian joined, and the sides fitted together, and the following timbers softened by the slow fire, and Pallas, with the oars prepared, seeking the arms on the sail-bearing mast.
